items.title: Anthropic’s CEO is about to have dinner with President Trump
items.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of leading AI firm Anthropic, is scheduled to meet with President Trump, signaling growing high-level engagement between AI industry leaders and political figures.

items.title: FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction-Generation Gap in Representation Autoencoders
items.summary: A new research paper introduces FuseReg, a method that uses layer fusion regularization to reduce the gap between reconstruction and generation in representation autoencoders, improving their performance.

items.title: Prompt Injection Is the New SQL Injection (and We're Not Ready)
items.summary: This article warns that prompt injection poses a security threat to AI systems comparable to SQL injection, highlighting a critical vulnerability that the industry is currently unprepared to handle.

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness: Toggling 'Reasoning Mode' Made One Model 5x More Likely to Follow Its Own Mistakes
items.summary: Research indicates that simply toggling a 'reasoning mode' in an AI model can significantly increase its tendency to repeat its own errors, raising concerns about the faithfulness of chain-of-thought reasoning.

items.title: InternW0-Δ: A World Action Model Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Actions with 20K+ Hours of Open Data
items.summary: A new world action model, InternW0-Δ, is introduced, leveraging over 20,000 hours of open data to bridge predictive dynamics and actions, advancing embodied AI capabilities.

items.title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
items.summary: A new method called 'Just Ask Jev' uses reinforcement learning to enable calibrated decisions, serving as a zero-shot detector for identifying AI alignment failures.

items.title: AI for everyone in every language
items.summary: Google announces new initiatives aimed at making AI accessible and useful to everyone, regardless of their language, emphasizing global inclusivity in AI development.

items.title: I Tried to Prompt a 3D DEV Library Into Existence. Then I Had to Build My Own Level Editor.
items.summary: A developer recounts the challenges of using AI to generate a 3D development library, ultimately leading to the necessity of building a custom level editor due to AI limitations.

items.title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
items.summary: A new paper explores how AI systems can be trained to discover and identify interesting mathematical concepts, potentially accelerating mathematical research.

items.title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
items.summary: ExplorationBench is presented as a new benchmark designed to measure and evaluate the exploratory capabilities of AI systems within complex, verifiable simulated environments.

items.title: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity
items.summary: Researchers introduce a novel block sparse attention mechanism that achieves log-linear complexity, offering significant efficiency improvements for large-scale transformer models.

items.title: PUBG Ally: A Conversational Embodied Agent as an AI Teammate
items.summary: A new paper introduces PUBG Ally, a conversational embodied AI agent designed to function as an intelligent teammate within the popular game PUBG, enhancing player experience.

items.title: Proaction boosts sales 60% and saves 75+ hours with Codex
items.summary: Proaction reports a 60% increase in sales and over 75 hours saved by integrating OpenAI's Codex into their operations, demonstrating significant business impact.

items.title: Can Muse overcome Meta’s trust issues?
items.summary: This article questions whether Meta's new AI initiative, Muse, can succeed in gaining public trust given the company's past controversies and challenges.

items.title: Co-creating the future of fashion with Google
items.summary: Google announces a collaboration to integrate AI into the fashion industry, aiming to co-create future trends and design processes.
